name.ja: 30MM 1/144 EXM-E7a スピナティア (アサシン仕様)

description.ja: 30MMシリーズに新たに加わった第３勢力「マクシオン軍」に、女性型の新機体「スピナティア」がアサシン仕様で登場！
description.en: A new female aircraft, "Spinatia ", is now available as an assassin in the third force " Maxion Army" that has newly joined the 30MM series!

description.ja: • 30MMシリーズに女性型の素体が新たに登場。
description.en: • A new female body has been added to the 30MM series.

description.ja: • 素体となる本体のほか、アーマーパーツ、武器パーツがひとつになったオールインワンアイテム。
description.en: • An all-in-one item that includes the main body, armor parts, and weapon parts.

description.ja: • 更に組み立てやすくなった新構造！可動範囲を活かしつつも組み立ての際の挟み込みは一切なし。
description.en: • New structure that is even easier to assemble! While taking advantage of the range of motion, there is no pinching during assembly.

description.ja: • 既存アイテムともミキシングできる共通関節構造、３mmジョイントを採用。
description.en: • Adopts a 3mm joint, a common joint structure that can be mixed with existing items.

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ　武器持ち手（左右）、平手（左右）、表情武器持ち手（右）
accessories.en: Hand parts Weapon holder (left and right), open hand (left and right), facial expression weapon holder (right)
